# Pushing a heavy block

<!-- STEP id="balanced" -->
Rahul pushes a 25 kg block on a level floor. The largest friction the floor can give is 50 N. If he pushes with 50 N, the forces balance. The net force is zero, and the block stays at rest.

<!-- STEP id="moves" -->
If he pushes with 55 N, the net force is 55 N - 50 N = 5 N. So a = F / m = 5 N / 25 kg = 0.2 m/s².

Starting from rest, in 2 s the block moves s = 1/2 x 0.2 m/s² x (2 s)² = 0.4 m.
